## PR title

`Render bullet markers at every nesting depth in DOCX list rendering`

## PR body

```markdown
## Summary

DOCX converter rendered list bullets only for the first two depths.
Three-level nested lists in `report.docx` came out with depth-3 items as
plain paragraphs instead of bulleted entries.

## Root cause

`docx_converter._render_list_item` short-circuited at `MAX_DEPTH=2`,
dropping the bullet marker. The depth limit existed to bound the indent
string but mistakenly suppressed the marker too. `_list_helpers` always
produced a sane indent for any depth.

## Fix

Remove the MAX_DEPTH guard from the call site. The indent helper already
handles arbitrary depth (`'  ' * depth + '- '`).

## Verification

`tests/test_docx_converter.py::test_three_level_nested_list_keeps_bullets`
asserts a bullet prefix at depths 0, 1, and 2. Fails on main (depth-2
bullet missing), passes on this branch.
```

## Fix summary

- Files touched: src/converters/docx_converter.py, src/converters/_list_helpers.py, tests/test_docx_converter.py

DOCX converter strips bullet points from nested lists at depth 3 or greater.

## Repro evidence

## Verification evidence
